rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a close, positive relationship, especially in phrases such as 維持良好關係.

example.english: We have maintained a good rapport, so working together has been smooth.
example.traditional: 我哋一直維持良好關係，合作起上嚟好順利。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jat1 zik6 wai4 ci4 loeng4 hou2 gwaan1 hai6 hap6 zok3 hei2 soeng5 lai4 hou2 seon6 lei6

rows.note: Choose this when the rapport emphasizes mutual understanding and communicating smoothly, often without needing to explain much.

example.english: They have such good rapport that they understand each other with just a glance.
example.traditional: 佢哋一個眼神就明白對方，真係好有默契。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jat1 go3 ngaan5 san4 zau6 ming4 baak6 deoi3 fong1 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 mak6 kai3

rows.note: Choose this for personal rapport based on familiarity, trust, or an established friendship rather than mainly professional cooperation.

example.english: I have a deep rapport with Old Chan, and we always help each other out.
example.traditional: 我同老陳識咗好多年，大家交情深，有咩事都會互相幫手。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 lou5 can4 sik1 zo2 hou2 do1 nin4 daai6 gaa1 gaau1 cing4 sam1 jau5 me1 si6 dou1 wui6 wu6 soeng1 bong1 sau2
